name: Steel Authority of India Ltd
title: Steel Authority of India Ltd - 500113 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: SAIL's Q4 FY26 volumes rose 4% to 5.3Mt with PAT up 43%; management guides FY27 sales to 22Mt and capex to Rs15,000 crore, with NSR up about Rs4,000/t since Q4 — but the capex ramp to Rs20,000-25,000 crore is a supply-side warning.

utilisation.quote: Our capacity is 21 million tons, and we are targeting to produce 22 million tons. I think it is 22.5 million tons

capex.quote: Guidance for '26 -'27 is INR15,000 crores. And since our expansion projects are ongoing in different, different plants. So in '27 -'28, the capex figures will be in excess of INR20,000 crores.

triggers.label: Long NSR Q4 → April Rs57,600/t
triggers.quote: NSR of long products is INR57,600 and NSR of flat is INR56,700
triggers.highlight: NSR of long products is INR57,600

triggers.label: Capex guide Rs15,000 cr → Rs20,000 cr+
triggers.quote: in '27 -'28, the capex figures will be in excess of INR20,000 crores

triggers.label: Inventory down ~1Mt in FY26
triggers.quote: stock reduction is around 0.9 million tons, out of which 0.4 million tons in saleable steel category
triggers.highlight: stock reduction is around 0.9 million tons

triggers.label: Q1-Q2 demand muted, destocking
triggers.quote: demand remains muted in quarter 1 and quarter 2, as all of us have seen, on the back of more sales in quarter 4
triggers.highlight: demand remains muted in quarter 1 and quarter 2

guidance.quote: in '27 -'28, the capex figures will be in excess of INR20,000 crores
We need to reduce further by INR20/kg in '26-'27.

guidance.value: 56 million tons FY26 target, 80 Mt ramp
guidance.quote: we have kept a target of 56 million tons, out of which some quantity will be sold
